title: Antica
description: Adds a new marble material, more gold block variants, structures and a music disc.
body:
**Antica** is a mod developed by **Hex** _(AKA HexTheSlime, HexGaming_ or HexGamingOnYT)_ that adds new building blocks such as marble, more variants of the gold block, new structures and a new music disc.

# More about the features
## Marble
Marble is a new block type that can occassionally replace stone, similar to blocks such as diorite, andesite or granite. It **only** generates between Y coordinates 0 and 64, so don't go looking for it in some obscurely high mountains.

### Marble - Crafting
Marble only generates in the form of Rough Marble, although it can be polished using a grindstone or crafting table. By placing 4 Rough Marble in a square pattern (like the one used for a crafting table) or putting it in a grindstone, you can obtain **Polished Marble** which can be crafted into **Marble Pillars** (by placing 2 Polished Marble above each other) and **Chiseled Marble** (by once again placing 4 **Polished** Marble in a square pattern). You can also obtain **Ornate Marble** by placing a Polished Marble block in the middle of a 3x3 crafting grid and putting 4 gold ingots in the corners. Finally, you can craft a **Marble Lantern** by putting a gold ingot, a lantern and 1 polished marble in a crafting grid (**this recipe is shapeless** - it will work no matter how you arrange the crafting ingredients). A Marble Lantern emits the same amount of light as glowstone. Additionally, if you are going for a more *ancient* vibe, you can combine 2 Rough Marble and 2 vines to craft Mossy Marble.

## Gold Block Variants
Apart from Marble, Antica also adds new variants of the **Gold Block** (or Block of Gold if you wanna be fancy).

### Gold Block Variants - Crafting
As of v0.3, there are only two custom variants for the Gold Block, these being the **Gold Pillar** (crafted by placing 2 Gold Blocks above each other, similar to the Marble Pillar) and the **Ornate Gold Block** (crafted by placing 4 Gold Blocks in a square pattern).

_Note: As of right now, the Gold Pillar crafting recipe returns 4 Gold Pillars instead of 2. This is a known bug and will be fixed in v0.4._

## Structures
Antica also adds brand new structures that utilize the new block types. One of these structures is the **Marble Plaza**, which contains the brand new **Respite music disc**. This music disc can be obtained from the Jukebox in the middle of the structure and is only 17 seconds long.
